receipt.public_excerpt: The two companies reportedly signed an agreement last year stating OpenAI has only achieved AGI when it develops AI systems that can generate at least $100 billion in profits. That’s far from the rigorous technical and philosophical definition of AGI many expect.

evidence_items.explanation: A recent case of AGI being redefined in financial rather than cognitive terms. This fits his point that some recast AGI in economic terms.

receipt.public_excerpt: The resulting AGI scores (e.g., GPT-4 at 27%, GPT-5 at 57%) concretely quantify both rapid progress and the substantial gap remaining before AGI.

evidence_items.explanation: A broad, human-level standard found a 'substantial gap' for a frontier model shortly before the post. This supports the view that the demanding standard had not been met.

evidence_items.publisher: Nature (Comment by Chen, Belkin, Bergen, Danks)

receipt.public_excerpt: The vision of human-level machine intelligence laid out by Alan Turing in the 1950s is now a reality.

evidence_items.explanation: Credentialed authors argued shortly before the post that the evidence shows human-level intelligence. It is an argument from a Turing-style standard, which is the redefinition he disputes, not a new measurement.
